ux: Create dialog is single-column: Task details, Execution, collapsed Advanced settings.
Dependency candidates exclude completed tasks; selected dependencies are chips with optional search.
Resource keys use a type/value builder (file, port, build, db, branch, other) and persist namespace:value.
Executor is a compact select defaulting to the workspace queue; analysis/review phase Sessions are filtered from current links and the audit ledger; busy Sessions are disabled.
Completion mode is a simple selector in Execution; instructions and machine checks remain in Advanced.
Analyze-before-execution and empty acceptance criteria are explained in plain language.
Create/cancel actions sit at the end of the form, not in a sticky footer.
limitations: The board had only completed tasks at verification time, so the live dependency list correctly showed no active candidates; the done-task exclusion is also covered by a contract test.
Dependencies and resource keys remain available in the collapsed Advanced section and in task detail; one-click application of analysis coordination suggestions is not part of this release.
Native/Lab use the deterministic simulator model; no live external-model lane is claimed for 1.9.3.
The queue remains stopped after the hot reload; the five board tasks remain done.
